title: ADU Models X, Y and Z
summary: Three detached accessory dwelling units for New York City's pre-approved plan library.
body: Three detached accessory dwelling units designed for New York City's pre-approved plan library — the programme that lets a homeowner build a backyard unit from a vetted design instead of commissioning a scheme from scratch.
Model X is a 643 sq ft one-bedroom on a 16 by 40 ft rectangular footprint under a single-pitch roof. Model Y turns the plan into an L. Model Z stacks 776 sq ft over two floors.
credit: Designed and drawn by me. Submitted to the city under a registered design professional of record.

title: 365 Frozen Ridge Road
summary: Interior design and a thirty-sheet documentation set for a proposed single-family house in Orange County.
body: A proposed single-family house on a 0.945-acre lot in Orange County. I took the approved shell and designed the interiors — layouts, finishes, joinery and lighting — then produced the full interior design drawing set & the renders.
credit: Architectural plans and elevations by others. Interior design, ID drawing set and renders by me.
